tests.validation:
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from main import app

client = TestClient(app)
def test_validation():
    for body in [{"price": -1, "quantity": 1}, {"price": 2, "quantity": 0}, {"price": 2, "quantity": -2}]:
        assert client.post("/quote", json=body).status_code == 422
    assert client.post("/quote", json={"price": 2, "quantity": 3}).status_code == 200
tests.authorization:
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from main import app

client = TestClient(app)
def test_authorization():
    assert client.get("/documents/1?user_id=7").status_code == 200
    for user in [0, 6, 8, -1]:
        assert client.get(f"/documents/1?user_id={user}").status_code == 403

from domain import average

def test_average():

    assert average([-4, 2]) == -1
